title: Pneumatic Tube Diagnosis & Chemical Vulcanization
summary: Systematic observation, water immersion acoustic leak localization, abrasive butyl buffing, and chemical cold-vulcanization.

claims.statement: Step 1: Submerge partially inflated tube in clean water vessel section by section while applying gentle stretch to identify micro-bubbles.

evidence_refs.cue_excerpt: Submerge partially inflated tube in clean water vessel section by section while applying gentle stretch to identify micro-bubbles.

claims.statement: Step 2: Sandpaper scuffing must abrade the glazed butyl mold-release layer in a circular zone larger than the patch to allow chemical solvent cross-linking.

evidence_refs.cue_excerpt: Sandpaper scuffing must abrade the glazed butyl mold-release layer in a circular zone larger than the patch to allow chemical solvent cross-linking.
